'''Langer''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A relative of [[Magda Ulbreck]], Langer was employed as a security guard on the [[Ulbreck Compound|moisture farm]] belonging to her [[Marriage/Legends|husband]], [[Wyle Ulbreck]]. Langer had a reputation as a good shot with a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] but had not had cause to fire in years before [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. During that year, Langer was guarding the Ulbreck's home when it came under attack from [[Orrin Gault]], [[Mullen Gault]], [[Veeka Gault]] and [[Jabe Calwell]] disguised as [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] in an attempt to scare Wyle Ulbreck into joining the [[Settlers' Call Fund]]. Langer shouted a warning, but was knocked unconscious by the attackers before he could open fire. The Ulbrecks escaped the attack with the help of the exiled [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]].
